describe.description: The creature is a large, quadrupedal, bear-like animal shown in right-facing profile standing on a pale ground with small patches of grass. Its body is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the legs and back and paler tan on the muzzle, lower neck, chest and belly. Multiple large, glossy, dark reddish-brown to black chitinous plates with fine segmented lines and bright reflections are set into the fur on the back, sides, neck, rump and outer legs. A single long, smooth, glossy dark horn curves up and forward from the forehead. The head is broad with a bear-like muzzle and nose, small dark eyes, and small rounded ears. It stands on four thick, clawed limbs and no tail or wings are visible.

describe.description: A large, shaggy brown bear-like quadruped shown in side profile facing right, standing on four thick furry legs with large clawed paws. Its body, head, ears, eyes and muzzle are bear-like with dense brown fur that is lighter on the chest and belly. A single long, glossy dark curved horn with small barbs rises from its forehead. Its back, neck, sides, rump and upper legs bear multiple glossy dark reddish-brown segmented shell-like plates, and a row of six small black oval spots sits in the flank fur below the large side plate. No wings or tail are visible.
